claims.summary: A local drive event entering node_10 that can propagate through a 2x2 mesh to any of 12 output endpoints via internal node routing.
claims.subject: flow_004_IONetwork_i_driveLocal_10
claims.explanation: The flow starts at i_driveLocal_10 into node_10, which can route the event to its local, east, or south outputs, or to internal wires w_drive10200 and w_drive10211. These wires connect to node_00 and node_11 respectively, enabling further propagation to all four nodes and their outputs. The 12 endpoints represent all possible exit points from the mesh.

claims.subject: node_10, node_00, node_11, node_01
claims.summary: Each nodeTop instance acts as a 5-input, 5-output routing switch that can forward events between any input and any output.
claims.explanation: Each node receives up to 5 drive inputs (4 directional + 1 internal wire) and produces up to 5 drive outputs (4 directional + 1 internal wire). The internal wires form a mesh connecting adjacent nodes. The node's internal logic determines which input events are forwarded to which outputs, enabling multi-hop propagation.
